node.title: Re^2: How to read serial port with Win32::SerialPort?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Maybe unrelated but as you are on Windows and using a 64bit perl (assuming this from the path name) you might be interested in [id://1179150] leading to [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=113337#txn-1691722|this fix].

I can confirm that I can reproduce the bug using the OP's code with the $PortObj->read(1) method on a 64-bit Strawberry Perl, but the same code does not produce the error on a 32-bit version.
